title: When “A Helpful Assistant” Is Not Really Helpful: Personas in System Prompts Do Not Improve Performances of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the performance of LLMs on objective, factual tasks (using the MMLU dataset) when assigned various personas. While it explores gender bias in persona performance and includes a section on 'Ethical Considerations,' it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a primary component of its study.
